text.id: Simple yet sophisticated, this beige shirt offers a clean and modern aesthetic that suits every occasion. Made with lightweight, soft-touch fabric, it provides a relaxed feel without compromising on style. Its neutral tone makes it easy to pair with jeans, chinos, or formal trousers, giving you flexibility from day to night. Designed for men who prefer understated elegance with all-day comfort.
